technicalLimitations: Metrics are per-axis accuracy on the frozen GSPC bank ONLY, not a general property.
A signature is an integrity claim, not a truth claim; see the signed cards.
Only cards that this exporter re-verified appear as metrics; an unverified card would be listed under csoai:unverified_cards, never as a measurement.

properties.name: csoai:card_verification_method
properties.value: Each referenced card id recomputed from its canonical body bytes and its Ed25519 signature verified under the pinned key did:web:csoai.org#card-attestation-1, read from public/signed/verify-card.mjs. A card carrying its own key is not authentic; only a pinned key is.

properties.name: csoai:evidence_corpus
properties.value: signed-card index (public/signed/card_index.json); 335 cards catalogued; packaged_at 2026-08-28T15:39:25.229647+00:00. The public-root leaf corpus and the mill-card corpus are separate corpora; they are not used here and are not merged into this one.

properties.name: csoai:honesty
properties.value: Assembled from the signed-card index only, and every referenced card was independently re-verified by this exporter. Does NOT stamp MEASURED; the evidence is the signed cards it references. A signature is an integrity claim, not a truth claim. Not a GSPC score.
